integrity.comparison_basis: A later full-text multiple-root-locus source was inspected for degree applications and searched for divisibility/common-divisor statements.
integrity.degree_formula_basis: The archival full text states Hilbert's projective-degree formula for coincident root loci.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The archival source displays arXiv:math/0311312v1 dated 2003-11-18.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The archival source explicitly lists AMS Subject classification 14N10, 57R45; its primary listed code is in algebraic geometry.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to coincident root loci indexed by partitions of length exactly three.
Only projective degrees are compared; dual, polar, equivariant, and Euclidean-distance degrees are outside the claim.
An unindexed older invariant-theory source could contain the same gcd consequence of Hilbert's degree formula.
title: Exact gcd law for degrees of three-dimensional coincident root loci
